modules.responsibility: Define recipe data, search, lookup, rail selection, and cookbook operations.
Expose recipe routes and APIs and select a presentation mode.
Render the TableStory brand and mobile recipe journey.
Render TV rails, detail layout, and spatial key navigation.
Verify contracts and document reproducible operation.

types.name: Recipe
types.definition: Mapping with the exact D1 fields and recipe-domain values.

types.name: RecipeRail
types.definition: Mapping containing a display name and ordered recipe_ids.

functions.error_behavior: Blank queries return all recipes; comparisons are case-insensitive.
Unknown saves return HTTP 400; repeated removes succeed.
Unknown IDs return the recipe-specific HTTP 404 page.
Clamp to available rails/cards and retain the nearest sensible card index.

call_flows.name: TV browse to detail and back

test_seams.boundary: Recipe domain and Flask JSON APIs
test_seams.strategy: Use deterministic unit and Flask client tests for data invariants, search, errors, cookbook, and rails.

test_seams.boundary: Rendered mobile/TV behavior and forbidden terminology
test_seams.strategy: Use DOM/browser checks plus a source-and-output terminology scan at both required viewports.
